sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
 equipment maintenance procedures which must be performed for liquid 
 fuel check valve when pressure difference between fuel nozzles pressure (∆P) > 
 75psi.

Check valve avoid the flow 
 divider speed to increase boundessly, so it permits
 the fuel to pass into 
 combustion chamber at certain pressure (90 to 100 psi).

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ahmed Badawy, reviewed by eng. 
 Mohamed Moussa Embaby, revised by inspection and quality control at EDEPC. 
 eng. Abouda EL Bana, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Abdel Hady Ahmed general 
 director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
يجب إيقاف تشغيل التوربينات.
Disconnect power supply to driver motor.
Closing all valves controlling flow (delivery and suction valves) of the pump.
Be sure pump must be completely drained.

sections.text:
Pressure Test Fuel Oil Check Valves before 
Valve Disassembly

Use 90 to 100 psi air pressure and submerge check 
 valve under water to check for leakage.

If check valve opened at range (90 to100 psi) it 
 be ok, and

إذا فتح قبل الضغط 90 رطل لكل بوصة مربعة أو بعد 100 
 يجب تفكيك رطل لكل بوصة مربعة لفحص الزنبرك والختم المرن.

sections.text:
صمام 
التفكيك

Mount valve vertically in a 
 vise or suitable holding fixture by clambing on hex of body portion ( outlet 
 side)

Using a box type wrench of 
 proper size on the hex of the cap (inlet side) turn counter clock wise.

Remove wrench and carefully 
 turn out cap by hand for last two or three threads. Lift off cap.

قم بإزالة جزء الجسم من الملزمة، ويمكن الآن استغلال الأجزاء الداخلية عن طريق ضرب الجسم باليد أو بأي شيء آخر 
 سطح ناعم .

sections.text: تقتيش

Check metal parts for damage, i.e., 
 for nicks, and scratches caused by fluid contaminents, replace any damaged 
 parts.
Discard old flexible seal.

sections.text: Valve Assembly:

Mount valve body vertically as on 
 disassembly

Drop spring into valve making sure 
 it seats properly on spring seat at outlet end.

Assemble seal retainer over nose of 
 poppet.

Select new flexible seal of proper 
 size.

Assemble flexible seal over nose of 
 poppet.

Drop poppet, seal retainer. and 
 flexible seal assembly into valve opening Poppet first.

Carefully start cap thread into 
 body thread and snug down with fingers

Tighten cap with box type wrench of 
 proper size.
